words.enDefinition: A test checking how two or more software components work together

examples.en: Our integration test checked that the reader passed dates to the report generator.
examples.zh: 我们的「集成测试」检查读取程序有没有把日期传给报告生成程序。

examples.en: The integration test used a small database shared by both components in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上的「集成测试」用一个小数据库供两个组件共用。

collocations: an integration test for two components

words.enDefinition: A test following a complete workflow through the relevant software system

examples.en: The end-to-end test created a practice booking and displayed its confirmation on screen.
examples.zh: 「端到端测试」创建了一笔模拟预订，并在屏幕上显示确认信息。

examples.en: We wrote an end-to-end test that began with an empty draft and exported a report.
examples.zh: 我们写了一个从空草稿开始、最终导出报告的「端到端测试」。

collocations: an end-to-end test of a workflow

words.enDefinition: A test focusing on the behaviour of an individual software component

examples.en: The component test exercised the date picker with the rest of the page absent.
examples.zh: 「组件测试」在页面其他部分都未加载时，测试了日期选择器。

examples.en: Our component test checked which unit the converter displayed after we changed its setting.
examples.zh: 我们的「组件测试」检查修改设置后，换算器显示了哪个单位。

collocations: a component test for a form

words.enDefinition: A quick check that a build's essential functions are working

examples.en: The smoke test checked whether the classroom app could open and create a draft.
examples.zh: 「冒烟测试」检查课堂应用能否打开并新建草稿。

examples.en: We used a smoke test before spending time on the longer checks.
examples.zh: 在花时间做更长的检查之前，我们先做了「冒烟测试」。

words.enDefinition: A test checking whether software meets agreed user or business requirements

examples.en: Our acceptance test checked the specified report layout against the assignment requirements.
examples.zh: 我们的「验收测试」按作业要求核对了指定报告的版式。

examples.en: The final acceptance test verified that the example task could be completed successfully.
examples.zh: 最后一项「验收测试」验证了示例任务能否成功完成。

words.enDefinition: A test checking that an existing behaviour still works after changes

examples.en: We added a regression test for the date format that had previously broken.
examples.zh: 我们给先前出问题的日期格式加了一个「回归测试」。

examples.en: The regression test checked that the revised converter still handled whole numbers.
examples.zh: 「回归测试」检查修改后的换算器是否仍能处理整数。

collocations: a regression test for a fix

words.enDefinition: A software check performed by a person following a procedure

examples.en: Our manual test involved clicking through the report screen and checking each label.
examples.zh: 我们的「手动测试」逐个点击报告界面的功能并核对各项标签。

examples.en: We logged a manual test while checking the larger layout on a tablet.
examples.zh: 我们在平板上检查大尺寸布局时，记录了一项「手动测试」。

collocations: record results from a manual test
a manual test of the interface

words.enDefinition: A software check executed by code or a testing tool

examples.en: The automated test compared the calculated total with the value in our worksheet.
examples.zh: 「自动化测试」把计算出的合计值与练习表里的值作了对照。

examples.en: I added an automated test for the room selector before class ended.
examples.zh: 下课前，我给房间选择器加了一个「自动化测试」。

collocations: an automated test for a calculation

words.enDefinition: Software that runs tests and reports their statuses or results

examples.en: The test runner listed several checks that completed before the class ended.
examples.zh: 「测试运行器」列出了下课前完成的几项检查。

examples.en: We used a test runner to execute only the checks for date formatting.
examples.zh: 我们用「测试运行器」只执行日期格式相关检查。

words.enDefinition: The process of locating tests available to run in a project

examples.en: The editor showed two checks after test discovery finished for the example project.
examples.zh: 示例项目的「测试发现」结束后，编辑器显示了两项检查。

examples.en: We checked the file name when test discovery failed to find our test.
examples.zh: 「测试发现」没找到我们的测试时，我们检查了文件名。

words.enDefinition: An error encountered while a framework locates and prepares tests

examples.en: The runner reported a collection error before executing any of our checks.
examples.zh: 运行器在执行任何检查之前报告了「测试收集错误」。

examples.en: We found the unfinished test declaration after investigating the collection error in class.
examples.zh: 课上调查「测试收集错误」后，我们发现有一处测试声明没写完。

words.enDefinition: A function containing an executable software check or group of checks

examples.en: The test function checked how the converter handled dates in two different years.
examples.zh: 「测试函数」检查换算器如何处理两个不同年份的日期。

examples.en: I kept the second test function separate because it examined a different behaviour.
examples.zh: 我保留了独立的第二个「测试函数」，因为它检查的是另一种行为。

words.enDefinition: Prepared data, objects, or state that tests can use reliably

examples.en: The test fixture supplied the same sample schedule to both file checks.
examples.zh: 「测试夹具」给两项文件检查提供了同一份日程样本。

examples.en: Our tutor created a test fixture containing three records for the report tests.
examples.zh: 导师为报告测试创建了一个包含三条记录的「测试夹具」。

collocations: provide data through a test fixture

words.enDefinition: A setting controlling how long a test fixture is shared

examples.en: The fixture scope determined whether the two tests shared one prepared object.
examples.zh: 「夹具作用范围」决定这两个测试会不会共用同一个准备好的对象。

examples.en: We compared fixture scope settings in a lab exercise with three checks.
examples.zh: 我们在包含三项检查的实验练习中比较了「夹具作用范围」设置。

collocations: a fixture scope limited to one test

words.enDefinition: Work done before a test to prepare the conditions it needs

examples.en: During test setup, we created a blank schedule before checking how the application handled a new entry.
examples.zh: 「测试准备」期间，我们创建一张空白日程表，再检查应用如何处理新条目。

examples.en: I moved the sample directory creation into test setup for the file tests.
examples.zh: 我把创建示例目录的操作移到了文件测试的「测试准备」阶段。

words.enDefinition: Work done after a test to release resources or restore state

examples.en: The temporary report disappeared during test teardown after the test recorded its result.
examples.zh: 测试记录结果后，临时报告在「测试清理」阶段被删除。

examples.en: Our test teardown returned the settings to their original values before the next check.
examples.zh: 下一项检查开始前，我们的「测试清理」把设置恢复为原值。

words.enDefinition: Keeping a test independent of state changes caused by other tests

examples.en: We improved test isolation by starting each check with a fresh schedule.
examples.zh: 我们让每项检查都从一张新的日程表开始，改善了「测试隔离」。

examples.en: The lesson illustrated test isolation by running the two checks in either order.
examples.zh: 这节课通过用两种顺序运行同样两项检查来说明「测试隔离」。

words.enDefinition: Input values or example records used to check software behaviour

examples.en: Our test data included a single room and bookings on two dates.
examples.zh: 我们的「测试数据」只有一个房间，以及两个日期的预订。

examples.en: I kept test data in a separate folder for the course exercises.
examples.zh: 我把课程练习的「测试数据」放在单独的文件夹里。

words.enDefinition: One test definition executed with several separate sets of parameters

examples.en: The parameterized test used three temperatures with corresponding results for each case.
examples.zh: 「参数化测试」使用三个温度，每种情况都有对应结果。

examples.en: We replaced repeated checks with one parameterized test for our classroom converter.
examples.zh: 我们用一个「参数化测试」替换了课堂换算器里的重复检查。

words.enDefinition: A check in a test specifying a condition that must hold

examples.en: The test assertion checked that the exported table contained the stored room name.
examples.zh: 「测试断言」检查导出的表格是否包含已存的房间名。

examples.en: We placed one test assertion after the example called the date helper.
examples.zh: 示例调用日期辅助函数后，我们加了一条「测试断言」。

words.enDefinition: A test check requiring the observed and expected values to match

examples.en: Our equality assertion compared the stored room name with a short expected value.
examples.zh: 我们的「相等断言」把所存房间名和一个较短的期望值作了比较。

examples.en: The equality assertion checked that both reports began with the same three headings.
examples.zh: 「相等断言」检查两份报告是否都以同样三个标题开始。

collocations: an equality assertion for two values

words.enDefinition: A test check requiring a specified exception from some code

examples.en: We added an exception assertion for an impossible date in the example parser.
examples.zh: 我们给示例解析器加了一条「异常断言」，测试一个不可能出现的日期。

examples.en: The exception assertion checked which error the converter raised for an empty value.
examples.zh: 「异常断言」检查换算器遇到空值时会抛出哪个异常。

collocations: an exception assertion for invalid input

words.enDefinition: A check accepting numeric results within a permitted difference from expectation

examples.en: Our tolerance-based assertion allowed a small difference after the two conversions.
examples.zh: 两次换算后，我们的「按容差判断的断言」允许有少量偏差。

examples.en: The tutor chose a tolerance-based assertion for the exercise with decimal measurements.
examples.zh: 导师为含小数测量值的练习选择了「按容差判断的断言」。

collocations: set a limit for a tolerance-based assertion

words.enDefinition: Explanatory text supplied for use when an assertion does not hold

examples.en: The assertion message identified the missing column in the generated table.
examples.zh: 「断言提示信息」指出生成的表格缺了哪一列。

examples.en: I updated the assertion message to include the name of the example file.
examples.zh: 我更新了「断言提示信息」，让它包含示例文件名。

words.enDefinition: A test that converts data and checks it survives conversion back

examples.en: The round-trip test saved a small timetable and then read it back.
examples.zh: 「往返转换测试」保存了一张小课表，再把它读回来。

examples.en: We added a round-trip test to check whether accented letters survived export and reload.
examples.zh: 我们加了「往返转换测试」，检查带重音符号的字母能否在导出和重新加载后保留。

collocations: a round-trip test for saved records

words.enDefinition: A test comparing current output with an already saved reference representation

examples.en: The snapshot test compared the new report headings with a saved copy.
examples.zh: 「快照测试」把新报告的标题与已保存的副本作了对照。

examples.en: Our snapshot test showed a change after the label order was revised.
examples.zh: 修改标签顺序后，我们的「快照测试」发现了变化。

collocations: review a change found by a snapshot test

words.enDefinition: Checking specified properties using many automatically generated inputs

examples.en: The lab used property-based testing to check whether sorting preserved the number of records.
examples.zh: 实验课用「基于性质的测试」检查排序后记录数是否保持不变。

examples.en: We introduced property-based testing after discussing which result properties should always hold.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了结果应始终满足哪些性质，再介绍「基于性质的测试」。

collocations: explore a property with property-based testing

words.enDefinition: A replacement for a real dependency used during software testing

examples.en: The test double provided a predictable clock time for the schedule formatter.
examples.zh: 「测试替身」向日程格式化器提供了一个可预期的时刻。

examples.en: Our tutor inserted a test double where the program usually requested a record.
examples.zh: 导师在程序通常会请求记录的位置放入了一个「测试替身」。

collocations: replace a service with a test double

words.enDefinition: A replacement dependency returning predetermined responses for a test

examples.en: The test stub returned a fixed room name whenever the example requested one.
examples.zh: 示例每次请求房间名时，「测试桩」都返回一个固定名称。

examples.en: We changed the test stub to return an empty list for another check.
examples.zh: 我们修改了「测试桩」，让它为另一项检查返回空列表。

collocations: replace a dependency with a test stub
a fixed response from a test stub

words.enDefinition: A test replacement used to check expected calls or interactions

examples.en: The mock object verified that the example requested the record only once.
examples.zh: 「模拟对象」验证了示例只请求了一次记录。

examples.en: Our mock object checked that the formatter sent the expected label to the output handler.
examples.zh: 我们的「模拟对象」检查了格式化器是否向输出处理程序发送了预期标签。

collocations: set expectations on a mock object
check calls to a mock object

words.enDefinition: A working simplified replacement used instead of a production dependency during tests

examples.en: We used a fake implementation that stored the schedule in memory for the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们用了一个「轻量的测试替代实现」，在内存中保存练习用的日程表。

examples.en: The fake implementation let us check saves and reads without opening a database.
examples.zh: 「轻量的测试替代实现」让我们可以先验证保存和读取功能。

words.enDefinition: A source or method identifying whether a test result is correct

examples.en: The manual calculation served as a test oracle for the example program.
examples.zh: 手算结果是示例程序的「测试判定依据」。

examples.en: We chose an independent spreadsheet as the test oracle for the comparison.
examples.zh: 我们选择一份独立电子表格作为比对时的「测试判定依据」。

collocations: the output of a test oracle

words.enDefinition: A test structure separating preparation, the tested action, and result checks

examples.en: The tutor used the Arrange-Act-Assert pattern to separate the three parts of a check.
examples.zh: 导师用「准备执行断言模式」把一项检查分成三个部分。

examples.en: I rewrote the example using the Arrange-Act-Assert pattern so each stage was visible.
examples.zh: 我用「准备执行断言模式」重写示例，让各阶段一目了然。

collocations: write a test using the Arrange-Act-Assert pattern

words.enDefinition: A test whose result does not satisfy its required checks

examples.en: The failing test showed that the new table had replaced a column heading.
examples.zh: 「未通过的测试」显示，新表格替换了一个列标题。

examples.en: We kept the failing test visible while comparing the two saved results.
examples.zh: 比较两份保存结果时，我们一直留着「未通过的测试」供查看。

words.enDefinition: A test intentionally left unexecuted because a condition or setting applies

examples.en: The skipped test needed a display that the lab machine did not have.
examples.zh: 这项「已跳过的测试」需要实验室机器没有配备的显示设备。

examples.en: I read the explanation for the skipped test in the test report.
examples.zh: 我读了测试报告里关于「已跳过的测试」的说明。

collocations: the reason for a skipped test

words.enDefinition: A test outcome anticipated to fail and marked separately in advance

examples.en: The runner reported an expected failure for the example unfinished export option.
examples.zh: 运行器把示例中尚未完成的导出选项报为「预期失败」。

examples.en: We marked the known outcome as an expected failure in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习中将已知结果标记为「预期失败」。

collocations: mark a test as an expected failure

words.enDefinition: A passing result from a test previously marked as expected to fail

examples.en: The unexpected pass made us check whether the old problem was still present.
examples.zh: 「意外通过」让我们去检查原有问题是否仍然存在。

examples.en: The tutor explained why the unexpected pass appeared after the formatter changed.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么格式化器改动之后出现「意外通过」。

collocations: an unexpected pass in the test output

words.enDefinition: A result indicating that a test exceeded its allowed execution time

examples.en: The report showed a test timeout while the exercise waited for a file.
examples.zh: 练习等待文件时，报告显示出现了「测试超时」。

examples.en: We checked which calculation had caused the test timeout on the shared machine.
examples.zh: 我们查看是哪项计算在共用机器上导致了「测试超时」。

collocations: a test timeout in a report

words.enDefinition: a test that can pass or fail across runs without a relevant change to the code under test

examples.en: The flaky test sometimes failed because two checks shared a temporary folder.
examples.zh: 两项检查共用临时文件夹，导致这个「结果不稳定的测试」偶尔失败。

examples.en: We reran the flaky test and compared its two different results.
examples.zh: 我们重新运行「结果不稳定的测试」，对比它的两种不同结果。

words.enDefinition: A condition in which test results depend on their execution order

examples.en: We found test order dependence when both checks reused the same editable schedule.
examples.zh: 两个检查复用同一张可编辑日程表时，我们发现了「测试顺序依赖」。

examples.en: The report described test order dependence after reversing the positions of two tests.
examples.zh: 报告在对换两项测试的位置后指出了「测试顺序依赖」。

words.enDefinition: A document or output summarising tests executed and their outcomes

examples.en: The test report listed the skipped checks below the passing ones.
examples.zh: 「测试报告」把跳过的检查列在通过的检查下方。

examples.en: I opened the test report to see which formatting example had failed.
examples.zh: 我打开「测试报告」，看是哪个格式示例没通过。

words.enDefinition: One execution of a selected collection of software tests

examples.en: The test run took longer after we added two file handling checks.
examples.zh: 添加两项文件处理检查后，「一轮测试执行」花的时间更长了。

examples.en: I saved the results from a test run before changing the example data.
examples.zh: 修改示例数据之前，我保存了「一轮测试执行」的结果。

words.enDefinition: A change causing software behaviour that previously worked to become worse

examples.en: The new formatter caused a software regression by dropping the last line.
examples.zh: 新格式化器漏掉最后一行，造成了「软件回归缺陷」。

examples.en: We confirmed a software regression after comparing the report with last week's version.
examples.zh: 与上周版本对照报告后，我们确认存在「软件回归缺陷」。

words.enDefinition: A description of unintended software behaviour submitted for investigation

examples.en: The bug report included a screenshot of the missing report heading.
examples.zh: 「缺陷报告」附了报告标题缺失的截图。

examples.en: I filed a bug report after the example exported a blank page.
examples.zh: 示例导出空白页后，我提交了一份「缺陷报告」。

words.enDefinition: A sequence of actions showing how a reported software issue occurs

examples.en: The report listed steps to reproduce for the duplicate title in the preview.
examples.zh: 报告写了预览出现重复标题的「问题复现步骤」。

examples.en: We followed the steps to reproduce using the example's three sample records in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上用示例的三条样本记录按「问题复现步骤」操作。

words.enDefinition: A small self-contained example that still demonstrates a particular problem

examples.en: We built a minimal reproducible example using just two dates and the formatter.
examples.zh: 我们只用两个日期和格式化器就做出了「最小可复现示例」。

examples.en: The tutor ran my minimal reproducible example before looking at the full worksheet.
examples.zh: 导师先运行了我的「最小可复现示例」，再看完整的练习表。

collocations: reduce code to a minimal reproducible example

words.enDefinition: A software change intended to correct a specific faulty behaviour

examples.en: The bug fix restored the missing label in our sample table.
examples.zh: 「缺陷修复」恢复了样表中缺失的标签。

examples.en: We checked the bug fix against the example that previously produced two headings.
examples.zh: 我们用先前会生成两个标题的示例核验了「缺陷修复」。

words.enDefinition: A recognised problem that is still present in the software

examples.en: The notes mentioned a known issue affecting the widest report layout.
examples.zh: 说明中提到一个影响最宽报告版式的「已知问题」。

examples.en: Our group added a known issue after checking the problem on a tablet.
examples.zh: 在平板上核实问题后，我们组记录了一个「已知问题」。

collocations: check the list of known issues

words.enDefinition: The extent to which a set of tests exercises specified software parts

examples.en: We checked test coverage after adding tests for both date formats.
examples.zh: 添加两种日期格式的测试后，我们核对了「测试覆盖程度」。

examples.en: The tutor explained how test coverage related to the paths tested.
examples.zh: 导师讲了「测试覆盖程度」与实际测试过的路径有何关系。

words.enDefinition: The proportion of executable statements exercised during the tests

examples.en: The statement coverage improved after the error message line was executed.
examples.zh: 执行到显示错误消息的语句后，「语句覆盖率」提高了。

examples.en: We calculated statement coverage from the statements marked during the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们根据练习期间标记的语句计算了「语句覆盖率」。

words.enDefinition: The proportion of possible decision branches exercised during a test run

examples.en: The branch coverage report showed that the alternative path had not been tested.
examples.zh: 「分支覆盖率」报告显示，另一路径尚未经过测试。

examples.en: We increased branch coverage by adding a case with no matching date.
examples.zh: 我们添加了一个日期完全不匹配的用例，提高了「分支覆盖率」。

words.enDefinition: A summary identifying software areas exercised or missed by tests

examples.en: The coverage report marked two lines that none of our checks executed.
examples.zh: 「覆盖率报告」标出了我们的检查都没执行到的两行。

examples.en: I compared the coverage report before and after the additional worksheet tests.
examples.zh: 我比较了添加练习表测试前后的「覆盖率报告」。

collocations: a line in a coverage report

words.enDefinition: A source line not executed by the measured software tests

examples.en: The uncovered line printed a warning that our example never triggered.
examples.zh: 「未覆盖的代码行」会输出一条示例始终未触发的警告。

examples.en: We read the uncovered line before deciding which input could reach it.
examples.zh: 我们先读了这条「未覆盖的代码行」，再判断哪种输入能执行到它。

words.enDefinition: A minimum coverage level required by a project's testing rules

examples.en: The class project met its coverage threshold after we added two checks.
examples.zh: 添加两项检查后，课堂项目达到了「覆盖率门槛」。

examples.en: We verified the configured coverage threshold before comparing the project reports.
examples.zh: 比较项目报告之前，我们先核对了配置里的「覆盖率门槛」。

words.enDefinition: A check that software performs its intended behaviour under valid conditions

examples.en: The positive test saved a booking whose date and location were valid.
examples.zh: 「正常输入测试」保存了一笔日期和地点都有效的预订。

examples.en: We added a positive test for a correctly formatted text record.
examples.zh: 我们为格式正确的一条文本记录加了「正常输入测试」。

collocations: a positive test for valid input

words.enDefinition: A check that software handles invalid inputs or unsupported situations appropriately

examples.en: The negative test checked the message shown for a calendar date that could not exist.
examples.zh: 「无效输入处理测试」检查输入一个不存在的日期时会显示什么消息。

examples.en: We wrote a negative test for an empty name in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们给练习中姓名为空的情形写了「无效输入处理测试」。

words.enDefinition: A test exercising values at or near a specified limit

examples.en: Our boundary-value test checked the highest score allowed by the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们的「边界值测试」检查了练习允许的最高分。

examples.en: We added another boundary-value test just below the minimum length for names.
examples.zh: 我们给略短于姓名最短长度的情况加了一个「边界值测试」。

collocations: a boundary-value test for a limit

words.enDefinition: The software, settings, and resources used while running a test

examples.en: The test environment stored the sample records in a separate temporary folder.
examples.zh: 「测试环境」把样本记录存放在一个独立的临时文件夹中。

examples.en: Our group checked which interpreter was installed in the test environment.
examples.zh: 我们组检查了「测试环境」安装的是哪个解释器。

words.enDefinition: Settings determining how a framework chooses and runs software checks

examples.en: I changed the test configuration to include the folder with file checks.
examples.zh: 我改了「测试配置」，把含文件检查的文件夹也加进去。

examples.en: The test configuration controlled which checks ran when class began.
examples.zh: 「测试配置」控制上课时执行哪些检查。

words.enDefinition: A table of combinations of conditions under which tests will run

examples.en: The test matrix listed two browsers and two sizes for the exercise.
examples.zh: 这项练习的「测试矩阵」列出了两种浏览器和两种尺寸。

examples.en: We compared which combinations had been tested against the test matrix.
examples.zh: 我们对照「测试矩阵」，看看哪些组合已经测试过。

collocations: a row of the test matrix

words.enDefinition: Storage for tracked project history and references managed by Git

examples.en: I opened the Git repository to compare this week's classroom example with last week's.
examples.zh: 我打开「Git 版本库」，比较本周与上周的课堂示例。

examples.en: Our group kept the exercise files together in one Git repository.
examples.zh: 我们组把练习文件集中存放在同一个「Git 版本库」里。

collocations: the history of a Git repository

words.enDefinition: A project history store accessed at a separate location

examples.en: Our team used a remote repository to share the campus map exercise.
examples.zh: 我们用「远程版本库」共享校园地图练习。

examples.en: The remote repository held both versions that our classmates had submitted.
examples.zh: 「远程版本库」保存了同学提交的两个版本。

words.enDefinition: The files currently present for editing in a versioned project

examples.en: The working tree still held the label I had just edited.
examples.zh: 「工作树」中仍有我刚编辑过的标签。

examples.en: We checked the working tree before comparing the edited files with history.
examples.zh: 我们先查看「工作树」，再把已编辑文件和历史版本作对照。

words.enDefinition: The place where selected changes are prepared for the next commit

examples.en: The staging area contained only the edits intended for our next commit.
examples.zh: 「暂存区」里只有我们计划放进下次提交的编辑内容。

examples.en: I reviewed the staging area before recording the correction to the sample report.
examples.zh: 我先检查「暂存区」，再记录对报告样本的更正。

collocations: add changes to the staging area
remove a file from the staging area

words.enDefinition: File versions or edits already selected for the next commit

examples.en: The staged changes included the rewritten heading but excluded the edits to my notes.
examples.zh: 「已暂存的改动」包括重写后的标题，笔记里的编辑没有选进去。

examples.en: We checked the staged changes to see which file would be recorded.
examples.zh: 我们查看「已暂存的改动」，确认哪份文件会被记录。

collocations: compare staged changes with the last commit

words.enDefinition: Working tree edits that have not been selected for the next commit

examples.en: The unstaged changes were still present after I recorded the selected correction.
examples.zh: 我记录了选定的更正后，「未暂存的改动」仍然存在。

examples.en: Our tutor compared unstaged changes with the files prepared for the next commit.
examples.zh: 导师把「未暂存的改动」和已为下次提交准备好的文件作了对照。

collocations: inspect unstaged changes in a file

words.enDefinition: Temporarily store uncommitted edits separately from the current working tree

examples.en: I had to stash changes before opening the tutor's version for comparison.
examples.zh: 我要先「搁置未提交的改动」，才能打开导师的版本作对照。

examples.en: We chose to stash changes while checking the older course example.
examples.zh: 查看较早的课程示例时，我们选择「搁置未提交的改动」。

words.enDefinition: Put temporarily stored Git changes back into a working tree

examples.en: I could reapply a stash after switching back to the formatting exercise.
examples.zh: 切回格式练习的分支后，我就可以「恢复搁置的改动」。

examples.en: The tutor showed when to reapply a stash while discussing temporary edits in Git.
examples.zh: 导师讨论 Git 中的临时编辑时，演示了何时可以「恢复搁置的改动」。

collocations: reapply a stash after switching back
reapply a stash to a branch

words.enDefinition: A file in a working tree that Git is not tracking

examples.en: The new worksheet appeared as an untracked file after I saved it.
examples.zh: 我保存新练习表后，它显示为「未跟踪文件」。

examples.en: I checked why the untracked file was absent from the recorded project history.
examples.zh: 我检查了为什么这个「未跟踪文件」没有出现在项目历史记录里。

words.enDefinition: Text describing the purpose of a recorded change in version history

examples.en: The commit message explained why we renamed a column in the example.
examples.zh: 「提交说明」解释了我们为什么给示例里的一列改名。

examples.en: I read the commit message before comparing the old and new files.
examples.zh: 我先读了「提交说明」，再比较新旧文件。

words.enDefinition: A hash identifying a particular Git commit object

examples.en: We copied the commit hash to make sure both groups reviewed the same revision.
examples.zh: 我们复制了「提交哈希值」，确保两个小组审阅的是同一修订版本。

examples.en: The commit hash identified the exact snapshot used for the classroom demonstration.
examples.zh: 「提交哈希值」标识了课堂演示使用的那份具体快照。

collocations: refer to a commit by its hash

words.enDefinition: The recorded sequence or graph of commits in a repository

examples.en: The commit history showed two improvements to the example after Monday's lesson.
examples.zh: 「提交历史」显示周一上课后，示例有过两处改进。

examples.en: I looked through the commit history to find when the title changed.
examples.zh: 我查看「提交历史」，找标题是什么时候改的。

words.enDefinition: A commit containing one coherent change that can be understood independently

examples.en: I made an atomic commit containing the heading change and its matching test.
examples.zh: 我做了一个「单一目的提交」，含标题改动和对应测试。

examples.en: Our tutor preferred an atomic commit for the classroom's formatting correction.
examples.zh: 导师希望用一个「单一目的提交」单独记录课堂上的格式修正。

words.enDefinition: Replace the latest commit with revised content or a revised message

examples.en: I needed to amend a commit because I had missed the example's updated heading.
examples.zh: 我漏了示例里更新的标题，所以需要「修改已有提交」。

examples.en: We practised how to amend a commit using a private classroom branch.
examples.zh: 我们用一个课堂个人分支练习了如何「修改已有提交」。

words.enDefinition: A branch used to develop a change separately from shared work

examples.en: We used a feature branch while adding the date selector to the sample.
examples.zh: 我们给示例添加日期选择器时，用了一个「功能分支」。

examples.en: The feature branch contained my edits without changing the shared exercise immediately.
examples.zh: 「功能分支」保存了我的编辑，课堂共用练习还没有改动。

words.enDefinition: the repository branch selected as the initial branch for normal browsing or checkout

examples.en: I checked which default branch our school repository displayed to new users.
examples.zh: 我查看了学校版本库向新用户显示的是哪个「默认分支」。

examples.en: The default branch still showed the class example before our proposed correction.
examples.zh: 「默认分支」仍显示我们提交更正建议前的课堂示例。

words.enDefinition: Change which branch supplies the files currently checked out

examples.en: I had to switch branches to read the tutor's copy of the example.
examples.zh: 我要「切换分支」才能读到导师那份示例。

examples.en: We planned to switch branches after reviewing the saved edits in class.
examples.zh: 我们计划在课上审阅保存好的编辑后「切换分支」。

words.enDefinition: The commit currently pointed to by a named branch reference

examples.en: The branch tip moved when I recorded another revision on that branch.
examples.zh: 我在该分支又记录一项修订时，「分支当前指向的提交」变了。

examples.en: We compared the branch tip with the commit used during the demonstration.
examples.zh: 我们把「分支当前指向的提交」与演示用的提交作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Git's reference to the currently checked-out branch or commit

examples.en: We checked the HEAD reference before editing the classroom files.
examples.zh: 我们编辑课堂文件前，检查了「HEAD 引用」。

examples.en: The tutorial diagram showed the HEAD reference pointing to the current branch.
examples.zh: 教程示意图显示，「HEAD 引用」指向当前分支。

words.enDefinition: A Git state with HEAD pointing directly to a commit

examples.en: I saw detached HEAD when viewing a particular old revision for the exercise.
examples.zh: 查看练习某个旧修订版本时，我看到了「分离头指针状态」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained detached HEAD using the stored copy from last week.
examples.zh: 导师用上周保存下来的副本解释了「分离头指针状态」。

collocations: inspect a revision in detached HEAD

words.enDefinition: A conflict Git cannot resolve automatically when combining different changes

examples.en: The merge conflict occurred because both groups edited the same table heading.
examples.zh: 两个小组都改了同一个表格标题，因此出现「合并冲突」。

examples.en: We reviewed both proposed headings before resolving the merge conflict.
examples.zh: 解决「合并冲突」之前，我们审阅了两种提议的标题。

collocations: a merge conflict in a file

words.enDefinition: Text Git inserts to show where competing edits require resolution

examples.en: I found a conflict marker above the two proposed versions of the label.
examples.zh: 我在该标签的两个提议版本上方找到了一个「冲突标记」。

examples.en: The tutor pointed to the conflict marker before comparing the affected lines.
examples.zh: 导师先指出「冲突标记」，再比较受影响的几行。

collocations: remove a conflict marker after resolution
a conflict marker in the file

words.enDefinition: A commit recording a merge with more than one parent

examples.en: We opened the merge commit to see where the two histories met.
examples.zh: 我们打开「合并提交」，查看两段历史记录在哪里会合。

examples.en: The merge commit appeared after our team's two versions were combined.
examples.zh: 我们组的两个版本合并后，出现了「合并提交」。

words.enDefinition: A merge advancing a branch pointer along existing history without a new commit

examples.en: The fast-forward merge moved the branch forward without creating another commit.
examples.zh: 「快进合并」把分支往前移，没有创建另一条提交。

examples.en: Our tutor drew a fast-forward merge when one branch directly followed the other.
examples.zh: 导师在一条分支直接承接另一分支时画出了「快进合并」。

words.enDefinition: Merging two versions using their common ancestor as a third input

examples.en: The three-way merge used the shared earlier version to compare both edits.
examples.zh: 「三方合并」用双方共用的早期版本来比较两项编辑。

examples.en: We drew three snapshots before explaining the three-way merge in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上先画了三份快照，再讲解「三方合并」。

collocations: a common ancestor in a three-way merge

words.enDefinition: A best common ancestor used to compare two lines of history

examples.en: We found the merge base before comparing the branches' different title edits.
examples.zh: 我们先找出「合并基点」，再比较两个分支对标题的不同修改。

examples.en: The diagram marked the merge base where the two example branches diverged.
examples.zh: 示意图在两个示例分支分叉处标出了「合并基点」。

collocations: compare changes from the merge base

words.enDefinition: Combining branch changes into a single new commit on the target branch

examples.en: Our group used a squash merge for the two related label corrections.
examples.zh: 我们组把两项相关标签更正放在一起进行「压缩合并」。

examples.en: The squash merge left one new commit in the example history.
examples.zh: 「压缩合并」在示例历史中留下一条新提交。

collocations: a commit created by a squash merge

words.enDefinition: Replay a branch's commits on top of a different starting commit

examples.en: The tutor showed how to rebase a branch onto the updated classroom example.
examples.zh: 导师演示了怎样把分支放到更新后的课堂示例上「变基」。

examples.en: I practised how to rebase a branch on a copy of the project.
examples.zh: 我在项目副本上练习怎样「对分支变基」。

collocations: rebase a branch onto newer history

words.enDefinition: to take the change introduced by a selected commit and apply it to the current line of development

examples.en: We could cherry-pick a commit to bring over only the revised report title.
examples.zh: 我们可以「选取并应用某个提交」，只把改过的报告标题带过来。

examples.en: The example showed when to cherry-pick a commit from the class demonstration branch.
examples.zh: 示例展示了什么时候该从课堂演示分支「选取并应用某个提交」。

collocations: cherry-pick a commit from another branch

words.enDefinition: Create a new commit reversing changes introduced by an earlier commit

examples.en: Our group chose to revert a commit after the example lost a label.
examples.zh: 示例少了一个标签后，我们组选择「以新提交撤回改动」。

examples.en: We learned why we might revert a commit rather than remove history entries.
examples.zh: 我们了解了什么时候会「以新提交撤回改动」来保留历史记录。

collocations: revert a commit without deleting history

words.enDefinition: Download repository objects and references from a remote without integrating them

examples.en: We used the editor to fetch changes before comparing the two branches.
examples.zh: 比较两个分支之前，我们用编辑器「获取远程改动」。

examples.en: I decided to fetch changes while keeping the current work unchanged.
examples.zh: 我决定「获取远程改动」，当前工作先保持原样。

words.enDefinition: Fetch remote work and integrate it into the current branch

examples.en: Our tutor showed how to pull remote changes into the classroom's example branch.
examples.zh: 导师演示了怎样把远程端的工作「拉取并整合」进课堂示例分支。

examples.en: We agreed to pull remote changes after finishing the shared comparison in class.
examples.zh: 我们商定在课上完成共同比较后「拉取并整合远程改动」。

collocations: pull remote changes into a branch
pull remote changes before starting work

words.enDefinition: Send a branch's commits to a remote and update its reference

examples.en: I wanted to push a branch containing the updated example for my partner.
examples.zh: 我想给同伴「推送分支」，里面有更新后的示例。

examples.en: The tutor showed where each group could push a branch for the exercise.
examples.zh: 导师指出了每个小组可以把练习代码的「分支推送」到哪里。

collocations: push a branch to a remote

words.enDefinition: The branch configured as the comparison or update source for another branch

examples.en: I checked which upstream branch was configured before fetching the example updates.
examples.zh: 获取示例更新之前，我查看了配置的「上游跟踪分支」是哪一个。

examples.en: The upstream branch had two new commits in our classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图里的「上游跟踪分支」有两条新提交。

words.enDefinition: A local reference recording the last known state of a remote branch

examples.en: Our diagram labelled a remote-tracking branch beside the local branch we edited.
examples.zh: 我们在图上所编辑的本地分支旁标出了「远程跟踪分支」。

examples.en: We compared the remote-tracking branch with the snapshot currently in our editor.
examples.zh: 我们把「远程跟踪分支」与编辑器当前的快照作了比较。

collocations: update a remote-tracking branch by fetching

words.enDefinition: Create a linked copy of an existing project on a hosting service

examples.en: We needed to fork a repository before editing our own hosted copy for class.
examples.zh: 编辑各自托管的课堂副本前，我们得先「派生远程版本库」。

examples.en: The assignment asked everyone to fork a repository and add one example file.
examples.zh: 作业要求每个人「派生远程版本库」，再加一份示例文件。

collocations: fork a repository for an exercise
fork a repository into a personal workspace

words.enDefinition: Create a local copy of a project's repository history and files

examples.en: Our first step was to clone a repository onto the classroom computer.
examples.zh: 我们的第一步是在教室电脑上「克隆版本库」。

examples.en: I chose to clone a repository before opening the source file in my editor.
examples.zh: 我决定先「克隆版本库」，再在编辑器里打开源文件。

words.enDefinition: A proposal to merge a set of changes into another branch

examples.en: My pull request described how the new example handled repeated names.
examples.zh: 我的「拉取请求」说明了新示例怎样处理重复的姓名。

examples.en: The tutor left a note on the pull request before class ended.
examples.zh: 下课前，导师在「拉取请求」里留了条备注。

words.enDefinition: A proposed merge marked as work still in progress

examples.en: We opened a draft pull request while the example still needed its final check.
examples.zh: 示例还缺最后一项检查时，我们创建了「草稿拉取请求」。

examples.en: The draft pull request let my partner see changes before I finished testing.
examples.zh: 「草稿拉取请求」让同伴能在我测完之前看到改动。

collocations: mark a draft pull request ready

words.enDefinition: The branch selected to receive the changes in a merge proposal

examples.en: We checked the base branch before submitting our example for review.
examples.zh: 把示例提交评审之前，我们先核对了「合并目标分支」。

examples.en: The wrong base branch made our comparison show unrelated edits from last week.
examples.zh: 「合并目标分支」选错了，对比里就显示了上周无关的编辑。

collocations: compare changes against the base branch

words.enDefinition: The branch containing changes proposed for merging into a different branch

examples.en: I added another correction to the head branch before asking for feedback.
examples.zh: 申请反馈前，我又给「变更来源分支」加了一项更正。

examples.en: The head branch held the example whose output our group had checked.
examples.zh: 「变更来源分支」保存了我们组核验过输出的示例。

collocations: compare the head branch with its base

words.enDefinition: Inspecting proposed code changes and giving feedback before integration

examples.en: During code review, my partner asked how the example handled blank rows.
examples.zh: 「代码评审」时，同伴问我的示例如何处理空行。

examples.en: The code review caught a heading that did not match the worksheet.
examples.zh: 「代码评审」发现一个和练习表不一致的标题。

words.enDefinition: Frequently integrating changes and verifying them with automated checks

examples.en: Our course used continuous integration to check each submitted version automatically.
examples.zh: 课程用「持续集成」自动检查每个提交的版本。

examples.en: The tutor drew a diagram showing where continuous integration ran the tests.
examples.zh: 导师画了一张图，展示「持续集成」在哪一步运行测试。

words.enDefinition: Keeping validated software ready for release through an automated process

examples.en: Our example of continuous delivery prepared a tested package for later release.
examples.zh: 我们的「持续交付」示例准备了一个经过测试的软件包，供之后发布。

examples.en: The diagram showed continuous delivery ending with a version ready for approval.
examples.zh: 图里，「持续交付」最后产出了一个待批准发布的版本。

words.enDefinition: An automated sequence of checks used to verify integrated changes

examples.en: The CI workflow built the classroom project before checking its sample output.
examples.zh: 「持续集成工作流」先构建课堂项目，再核对其示例输出。

examples.en: We read the CI workflow before adding a check for date formatting.
examples.zh: 我们先读了「持续集成工作流」，再添加日期格式检查。

words.enDefinition: An event or condition that starts an automated workflow

examples.en: The workflow trigger started our class checks whenever we uploaded a revision.
examples.zh: 每当我们上传修订版本，「工作流触发条件」就启动课堂检查。

examples.en: We checked which workflow trigger applied when the exercise ran that morning.
examples.zh: 练习那天上午运行时，我们核对了当时满足的是哪个「工作流触发条件」。

collocations: a schedule as a workflow trigger

words.enDefinition: One execution of an automated workflow with its configured jobs

examples.en: The workflow run showed separate results for building and checking the example.
examples.zh: 这「一轮工作流执行」分别显示了构建和检查示例的结果。

examples.en: I opened the workflow run associated with the revision from our demonstration.
examples.zh: 我打开了与演示所用修订版本对应的「一轮工作流执行」。

words.enDefinition: A group of automated steps performed together within a workflow

examples.en: One workflow job checked the spreadsheet export after the build completed.
examples.zh: 构建完成后，一个「工作流作业」检查了电子表格导出。

examples.en: We renamed the workflow job to describe the classroom calculation it ran.
examples.zh: 我们给「工作流作业」改了名，好让人明白它运行的是哪项课堂计算。

words.enDefinition: One action or command executed as part of a workflow job

examples.en: The final workflow step saved the test report for us to review.
examples.zh: 最后一个「工作流步骤」保存了测试报告供我们审阅。

examples.en: We checked which workflow step had installed the required tools in class.
examples.zh: 我们核对了课堂上是哪个「工作流步骤」安装了所需工具。

words.enDefinition: A machine or process that executes jobs for continuous integration

examples.en: The CI runner executed the same tests we had run in class.
examples.zh: 「持续集成运行器」执行了我们在课堂上跑过的同样一组测试。

examples.en: The logs showed which CI runner had built our sample package.
examples.zh: 日志显示了是哪个「持续集成运行器」构建了我们的示例软件包。

collocations: run jobs on a CI runner
a log from a CI runner

words.enDefinition: A workflow job run separately for each selected settings combination

examples.en: The matrix job repeated our checks for two supported interpreter versions.
examples.zh: 「矩阵作业」对两个受支持的解释器版本分别运行了同一组检查。

examples.en: We read one result from the matrix job after testing both platforms.
examples.zh: 两种平台都测过后，我们读了「矩阵作业」的一项结果。

collocations: view results from a matrix job
a matrix job for multiple versions

words.enDefinition: An automated task producing compiled files, packages, or other build outputs

examples.en: The build job produced a classroom package before any tests ran.
examples.zh: 还没有运行任何测试时，「构建作业」先产出了课堂用的软件包。

examples.en: We opened the build job to see whether the package was created.
examples.zh: 我们打开「构建作业」，检查是否生成了软件包。

words.enDefinition: A configured check that must meet result criteria before a merge

examples.en: A required status check showed that the class project still needed its tests.
examples.zh: 一项「必需的状态检查」显示，课堂项目的测试还没完成。

examples.en: We reviewed the required status check associated with the proposed label change.
examples.zh: 我们审阅了与拟修改标签有关的「必需的状态检查」。

collocations: wait for a required status check

words.enDefinition: Stored dependency files reused instead of being retrieved on every run

examples.en: The dependency cache held files downloaded by the earlier class build.
examples.zh: 「依赖项缓存」保存了先前课堂构建下载的文件。

examples.en: We compared logs from builds with and without a dependency cache.
examples.zh: 我们对比了使用和未使用「依赖项缓存」的两次构建日志。

words.enDefinition: The recorded messages and results produced during a software build

examples.en: I checked the build log to see where the example package was saved.
examples.zh: 我查了「构建日志」，确认示例软件包存放在哪里。

examples.en: The build log recorded a warning about an optional report file.
examples.zh: 「构建日志」记录了一条关于可选报告文件的警告。

collocations: a warning in the build log

words.enDefinition: A file or collection of files saved from a build

examples.en: The build artifact included instructions alongside the program built in our lab.
examples.zh: 「构建产物」包括实验课上构建的程序及其说明。

examples.en: I downloaded the build artifact before comparing its contents with the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我先下载了「构建产物」，再把内容和练习表作对照。

words.enDefinition: The time a saved workflow output remains available to retrieve

examples.en: The artifact retention period covered both days of our classroom build exercise.
examples.zh: 「产物保留期限」覆盖了课堂构建练习的两天。

examples.en: We checked the artifact retention period before opening the older test report.
examples.zh: 打开较早的测试报告之前，我们先查了「产物保留期限」。

words.enDefinition: A packaged file made available as part of a software release

examples.en: The release artifact contained the application and a short classroom guide.
examples.zh: 「发行产物」包含应用和一份简短的课堂指南。

examples.en: We inspected the release artifact before sharing the sample version with classmates.
examples.zh: 把示例版本分享给同学前，我们先检查了「发行产物」。

collocations: check the contents of a release artifact

words.enDefinition: A named reference marking a specific version in repository history

examples.en: We used a version tag to identify the exact code discussed in class.
examples.zh: 我们用「版本标签」标识课堂上讨论的那份具体代码。

examples.en: I checked which revision corresponded to the version tag in our notes.
examples.zh: 我查了笔记中的「版本标签」对应哪个修订版本。

collocations: a commit marked by a version tag

words.enDefinition: a Git tag stored as its own object with metadata such as the tagger, date and message

examples.en: The annotated tag included a short note about the classroom example.
examples.zh: 「附注标签」包含一段关于课堂示例的简短说明。

examples.en: I opened the annotated tag to see the message recorded with it.
examples.zh: 我打开「附注标签」，查看随标签记录的消息。

collocations: a message on an annotated tag

words.enDefinition: A maintained history summarising changes across versions of a project

examples.en: The changelog listed changes from several weeks of our exercises.
examples.zh: 「版本变更记录」列出了几周练习里的改动。

examples.en: We consulted the changelog to see when the old label disappeared.
examples.zh: 我们查阅「版本变更记录」，看看旧标签何时被移除。

collocations: add an entry to the changelog

words.enDefinition: A scheme using version number changes to signal compatibility and updates

examples.en: The handout used semantic versioning to explain three parts of a version number.
examples.zh: 讲义用「语义化版本管理」解释版本号的三个部分。

examples.en: We checked the compatibility rule before assigning a number under semantic versioning.
examples.zh: 按「语义化版本管理」分配版本号前，我们检查了兼容性规则。

words.enDefinition: the first number of a semantic version, increased for incompatible public API changes after the initial development series

examples.en: The class example changed its major version after altering the public API incompatibly.
examples.zh: 课堂示例进行了不兼容的公开 API 修改，因此变更了「主版本号」。

examples.en: We compared the first numbers to identify the major version of each package.
examples.zh: 我们比较了首位数字，确定每个包的「主版本号」。

words.enDefinition: the second number of a semantic version, increased for backward-compatible new functionality or when public functionality is marked deprecated

examples.en: The example increased its minor version after adding a compatible formatting option.
examples.zh: 示例新增一个兼容的格式化选项后，提高了「次版本号」。

examples.en: We pointed to the middle number while explaining the minor version in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上说明「次版本号」时指着中间那个数字。

words.enDefinition: the third number of a semantic version, increased for backward-compatible bug fixes in a normal release

examples.en: The exercise increased the patch version after correcting the reported label display.
examples.zh: 练习修正了报告中的标签显示问题后，提高了「修订版本号」。

examples.en: I identified the patch version before comparing the package with its earlier build.
examples.zh: 我先找出「修订版本号」，再把该软件包与之前的构建版本比较。

words.enDefinition: A change that makes some previously supported usage stop working

examples.en: Removing the old argument caused a breaking change in the course example.
examples.zh: 删除旧参数在课程示例中造成了一项「破坏兼容性的更改」。

examples.en: We noted the breaking change beside the updated function description in our notes.
examples.zh: 我们在笔记里更新后的函数说明旁记下了这项「破坏兼容性的更改」。

words.enDefinition: The ability of a newer version to support earlier users or formats

examples.en: The example kept backward compatibility by accepting both versions of the report file.
examples.zh: 示例同时接受两个版本的报告文件，从而保持「向后兼容性」。

examples.en: Our tests checked backward compatibility with notes saved during the previous lesson.
examples.zh: 我们的测试核查了能否「向后兼容」上一课保存的笔记。

collocations: ensure backward compatibility with saved files

words.enDefinition: A message warning that a feature is discouraged or may be removed

examples.en: The deprecation notice explained that the old formatter might be removed later.
examples.zh: 「弃用通知」说明旧格式化器后续可能被移除。

examples.en: We read the deprecation notice before comparing the old and new options.
examples.zh: 我们先读了「弃用通知」，再比较新旧两个选项。

collocations: a deprecation notice for a feature

words.enDefinition: A version identified as preceding its corresponding final software release

examples.en: The pre-release version let us try the new layout before its final release.
examples.zh: 「预发行版本」让我们在最终发行前能先试用新版式。

examples.en: I used a pre-release version for the exercise while reporting its known limitations.
examples.zh: 我用「预发行版本」做练习，同时报告了已知限制。

words.enDefinition: A prerelease build that may become final if validation succeeds

examples.en: Our release candidate still needed the final check on the classroom computer.
examples.zh: 我们的「候选发行版」还需要在教室电脑上做最后一项检查。

examples.en: We compared the release candidate with the build used in the previous class.
examples.zh: 我们把「候选发行版」与上一堂课所用的构建版本作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A named stream delivering versions with a particular level of readiness

examples.en: The guide assigned preview builds to a separate release channel.
examples.zh: 指南把预览构建版本放在一个独立的「发行渠道」里。

examples.en: I checked which release channel supplied the version shown in our worksheet.
examples.zh: 我查看了练习表所示版本由哪个「发行渠道」提供。

words.enDefinition: Optional version information identifying a build without changing its version precedence

examples.en: The guide used build metadata to record the identity of the classroom build.
examples.zh: 指南用「构建元数据」记录课堂构建的标识。

examples.en: We compared build metadata for two builds that shared the same version.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两个版本号相同的构建的「构建元数据」。

collocations: a version string containing build metadata

words.enDefinition: The ordering used to compare versions under a chosen versioning scheme

examples.en: We used version precedence to decide how the two version labels should sort.
examples.zh: 我们用「版本先后顺序」判断两个版本标签应该怎么排序。

examples.en: Our notes explained version precedence for the preview and the final release.
examples.zh: 笔记说明了预览版与最终发行版的「版本先后顺序」。

words.enDefinition: A branch used to prepare and stabilise a particular software release

examples.en: The release branch held small corrections for our final classroom package.
examples.zh: 「发行分支」存放了为最终课堂软件包所做的小修改。

examples.en: We left the new feature off the release branch for that exercise.
examples.zh: 那次练习里，我们没把新功能放进「发行分支」。

collocations: a fix on a release branch

words.enDefinition: A release package with source and metadata for building the software

examples.en: The source distribution included the source files used in our classroom demonstration.
examples.zh: 「源代码发行包」包含我们课堂演示中使用的源文件。

examples.en: We opened the source distribution before reading its instructions for building the example.
examples.zh: 我们先打开「源代码发行包」，再读里面关于构建示例的说明。
